description: This file contains a script for managing ip6tables rules, including setup, verification, and cleanup of IPv6 firewall rules related to specific TCP ports and logging, with conditional handling for missing ip6tables and optional network interface detection.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines an alias for remote command execution, defaulting to CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND or empty.

methods.name: Skip if ip6tables missing
methods.description: Checks for the presence of ip6tables, outputs ip6tables-missing if not found.

methods.name: Detect LAN_IF6
methods.description: Detects the LAN interface for IPv6 using ip and awk commands.

methods.name: Insert LOG/ACCEPT and optional mangle MARK
methods.description: Adds ip6tables rules for logging, accepting specific TCP traffic, and marking packets in the mangle table.

methods.name: Verify LOG rule
methods.description: Checks if the logging rule exists in ip6tables.

methods.name: Verify ACCEPT rule
methods.description: Checks if the ACCEPT rule exists in ip6tables.

methods.name: Verify optional mangle MARK
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the mangle table mark rule.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes the previously added ip6tables rules.
